verses.text: Ask the LORD for rain in spring. The LORD makes storm clouds and sends showers, giving everyone in the fields what they need.
Household idols speak nonsense, and fortune-tellers see lies. They tell false dreams and offer empty comfort. So the people wander like sheep, suffering because they have no shepherd.
“My anger burns against the shepherds, and I’ll punish the male goats. The LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the people of Judah, and will make them like a royal warhorse.
“From Judah will come the cornerstone, the tent peg, the battle bow, and every kind of ruler.
“They’ll be warriors who trample muddy streets in battle. They’ll fight because the LORD is with them, and the horse riders will be thrown into confusion.

“I’ll strengthen Judah’s family and save Joseph’s family. I’ll bring them back because I have compassion on them. It will be as though I never rejected them, because I am the LORD their God, and I’ll answer them.
“Ephraim will be like a warrior. Their hearts will rejoice as if they’d been drinking wine. Their children will see it and celebrate; their hearts will be glad in the LORD.
“I’ll whistle for them and gather them, because I’ve redeemed them. They’ll become as numerous as before.
“I scattered them among the peoples, but in distant lands they’ll remember me. They and their children will live and then return.
“I’ll bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I’ll lead them into Gilead and Lebanon, and there won’t be room enough for them.
“They’ll pass through a sea of distress. I’ll strike the waves, and the Nile’s depths will dry up. Assyria’s pride will fall, and Egypt’s royal power will disappear.
“I’ll make them strong in the LORD, and they’ll live by his name,” says the LORD.
